en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. ‘Ubaydullāḥ ibn Faďl ibn Muḥammad ibn Hilāl narrated to me from ‘Abdil Raḥmān, from Sa’īd ibn Khaytham, from his brother Mu’ammar, who said: I heard Zayd ibn ‘Ali say:

Allāh will forgive all of the sins of those who go to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.) seeking nothing but nearness to Allāh, the Exalted, even if their sins are as great as the scum (found) in the sea. Therefore, you should go to his Ziyārah increasingly so that Allāh may forgive your sins.
